Internet Governance · Global Mumbai, India · March 2026

NextGen Fellow
ICANN 85

Selected as a NextGen Fellow at ICANN's global Community Forum in Mumbai — one of the most prestigious fellowships in internet governance. Advocated for youth-centric cybersecurity standards and global DNS stability, strengthening the voice of underrepresented regions in global identifier coordination.

Internet Governance · Australia Canberra, Australia · 2025

Opening Panel Speaker
auIGF 2025

Delivered the youth address at the opening panel of Australia's Internet Governance Forum, speaking on digital trust, online safety, and the real implications of Australia's social media age restrictions. Co-authored the "Designing Australia's Digital Duty of Care" report, leading to the official formation of the auIGF NextGen Taskforce and a 2026–27 implementation roadmap.

Digital Duty of Care · NextGen Taskforce

Selected as Youth Leader and Mentor at the Asia Pacific Internet Governance Academy, representing 20 different economies. Facilitated mock ICANN forums and co-developed IGF proposals on "Cybersecurity and Trust Worthy of Youth", building regional consensus among 39 international participants.
